home.brandDescription: Our power strips are designed to blend seamlessly into your workspace and home. Every product features premium surge protection, USB-C fast charging, and smart connectivity — because your devices deserve better power.
home.promoSubtitle: USB-C power strips up to 30% off, full-speed charging for all your devices.
home.faqSubtitle: Here are the most common questions from our customers
home.faq1Q: What voltage standards do Misicheng products support?
home.faq1A: Our products support global voltage standards from 100V to 240V, covering the US, EU, UK, Australia, China, Japan, and more. Each product clearly indicates its applicable voltage range and plug type.
home.faq2Q: How to submit a bulk purchase inquiry?
home.faq2A: You can add products to the cart and submit an inquiry form, or contact our sales team directly. We offer competitive pricing for bulk orders and support customization.
home.faq3Q: What safety certifications do the products have?
home.faq3A: Our products have obtained multiple international certifications including CE, FCC, UL, RoHS, and CCC. Different products may have different certifications depending on the target market.
home.faq4Q: What is the shipping coverage and delivery time?
home.faq4A: We ship worldwide. Domestic orders typically arrive in 3-5 business days, international orders in 7-15 business days. We support DHL, FedEx, and sea freight.
home.faq5A: All products come with a 12-month warranty. During the warranty period, we provide free repair or replacement for quality issues. We also offer lifetime technical support.
home.bannerTitle3: Professional Power Protection, Every Watt Counts
home.bannerSubtitle1: Smart power strips, USB-C fast charging, independent controls and remote connectivity for a cleaner, more efficient home and office.
home.bannerSubtitle2: GaN high-efficiency fast charging with multi-layer protection for phones, tablets, laptops and small appliances.
home.bannerSubtitle3: From surge protection to overload protection, from flame-retardant housing to precision engineering, providing stable power for critical devices.
home.testimonial1Comment: The smart WiFi power strip is amazing! I can control all devices from my phone, and the energy monitoring feature is very practical. Excellent build quality, highly recommended!
home.testimonial2Comment: Finally found a power strip that can charge my MacBook at full speed! The 100W GaN charger is compact and runs cool. One strip replaced three chargers.
home.testimonial3Comment: Strong airflow and solid build quality. It works well in our warehouse during summer.
home.testimonial4Comment: A must-have for weekly business trips! This travel power strip is super slim, fits easily in a laptop bag, and the international adapter is a bonus.
home.testimonial5Comment: The under-desk mounting design is brilliant! My workspace is instantly cleaner, easy to install, and the cable clips are a nice touch.
home.testimonial6Comment: The wireless charging hub is very convenient. Just place the phone on it to charge, and the USB-C port charges the iPad fast enough too.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to your most important questions here
faq.cat1Q1: What certifications and quality checks do Misicheng air products have?
faq.cat1A1: Misicheng products follow applicable safety and quality standards by product type and destination market. Please confirm certification requirements with sales before ordering.
faq.cat1Q2: How do I choose the right airflow or fan size?
faq.cat1A2: Selection depends on room size, airflow target, installation position, duct length, noise requirements and operating environment. Share your use case and we can recommend suitable models.
faq.cat1Q3: Can I request a quotation for bulk orders or OEM projects?
faq.cat1A3: Yes. Add products to the cart and submit your quantity, customization and delivery requirements. Sales will reply with a matched quotation.
faq.cat1Q4: Do you offer air cooling and heating products?
faq.cat1A4: Yes. The catalog includes air coolers, portable air conditioners, kitchen air conditioners, diesel heaters and carbon crystal electric heaters.
faq.cat2A1: We support multiple payment methods including credit/debit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, Alipay, WeChat Pay, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and more. All payments are transmitted via SSL encryption to ensure your payment security.
faq.cat2Q2: Can I modify my order after placing it?
faq.cat2A2: After submitting an order, if it hasn't been shipped yet, you can request modifications in 'My Orders'. If the order has already been shipped, modifications are not possible, but you can apply for a return or exchange after receiving the product. For urgent modifications, please contact our customer service team.
faq.cat2Q3: How can I check my order status?
faq.cat2A3: Log in to your Misicheng account and go to the 'My Orders' page to view the real-time status of all your orders. After shipping, you'll also receive an email notification with a tracking number so you can track your package at any time.
faq.cat3A1: Typically, we ship within 1-2 business days after order confirmation. During major promotions, this may extend to 3-5 business days. After shipping, domestic delivery usually takes 2-5 days, and international shipping takes 7-15 business days (varies by destination).
faq.cat3A2: Domestic orders over ¥99 qualify for free shipping; orders under ¥99 incur an ¥8 shipping fee. International shipping is calculated based on destination and package weight, displayed automatically at checkout. Some promotional periods may offer free shipping.
faq.cat3A3: Yes, Misicheng ships to over 30 countries and regions worldwide. International orders are delivered via DHL, FedEx, UPS, and other international courier services with full tracking.
faq.cat4Q1: Can I return a product if I'm not satisfied?
faq.cat4A1: Absolutely. Misicheng offers a 30-day no-questions-asked return policy. Within 30 days of receiving your product, as long as it's in its original packaging and unused, you can apply for a return and refund. Return shipping is on us.
faq.cat4Q2: What if I receive a defective product?
faq.cat4A2: If you receive a product with quality issues, please contact our customer service team within 7 days of delivery with product photos and order information. We'll arrange a free replacement or full refund, and we'll cover the return shipping costs.
faq.cat4Q3: How long does a refund take?
faq.cat4A3: After we verify the returned product, the refund will be processed within 3-5 business days back to your original payment method. Credit card refunds may take an additional 1-2 billing cycles to appear on your statement.

aboutTech.heading: About Misicheng · Technology & Strength
aboutTech.intro1: Misicheng focuses on air movement, ventilation, cooling and heating equipment for residential, commercial and industrial buyers worldwide.
aboutTech.intro2: We prioritize dependable airflow, practical installation, stable operation and responsive quotation support for every product line.
aboutTech.tech1Desc: Air curtains, fans, coolers, purifiers and exhaust equipment help improve comfort, circulation and indoor air quality across different spaces.
aboutTech.tech2Desc: Products are selected and inspected for stable operation, durable materials and practical safety requirements according to model and market needs.
aboutTech.tech3Desc: Multiple models support different installation needs, including wall-mounted, ceiling-mounted, ducted, portable and floor-standing applications.
aboutTech.tech4Desc: The product range covers airflow, purification, cooling, heating and extraction scenarios for homes, shops, kitchens, factories and temporary worksites.
aboutTech.tech5Desc: Sales support can help match airflow, voltage, installation size and order quantity before quotation.
aboutTech.tech6Desc: From small fans to industrial ventilation equipment, the catalog supports both single-product purchasing and project-based sourcing.
aboutTech.tech7Desc: Advanced copper-core heat dissipation with thermally conductive silicone pads and ventilated housing design. Operating temperature stays below 45°C even at full load. NTC thermistor monitors temperature 100 times per second, auto-shutoff at 85°C.
aboutTech.tech8Desc: ISO 9001 certified manufacturing with 100% automated optical inspection (AOI) and high-voltage insulation testing on every unit. 72-hour burn-in aging test simulates 3 years of use. 18-month warranty with 7×24 global after-sales support.
